goal: Render homepage popular searches as one accessible horizontal slider row on every viewport.

facts.claim: The current mobile stylesheet forces the popular-search cards into a two-column grid.

invariants: All ten managed links remain present
Existing images and copy remain unchanged

requirements.statement: Popular searches never wrap into a second row.
Visitors can move horizontally through the complete list.
All existing destinations and card content remain intact.
The rail is usable and contained on desktop and mobile.

acceptance_checks.observable_result: All ten cards are direct items of one non-wrapping horizontal track.
Rail scroll position changes while page position does not.

acceptance_checks.action: Swipe or horizontally scroll the popular-search rail
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Cards remain in one row, later cards become reachable and the document has no horizontal overflow.

acceptance_checks.action: Reload and open a popular-search link
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The original localized destination still opens.

acceptance_checks.setup: Rail is already at an edge
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The unavailable direction is semantically disabled and no duplicate navigation occurs.

authorization_boundary: Local implementation and verification only; no publication.
